caption_L1: Number of unemployed people in Belgium from 2008 to 2019 is a area graph. On the y-axis, Number of unemployed people is shown. The x-axis shows Year along a linear scale of range 2008 to 2018.
caption_L2L3: The number of unemployed people in Belgium has been very unsteady and has changed throughout the years. This steadily increased between 2008 and 2010, which had then dropped between 2010 and 2011. It had then increased again and peaked at 2014 at 420,000 people, and then steadily declined after that until 2018 to 300,000 people.
